wiki_only_topics.topic: Connection to Rome via the Via Tiburtina and Via Valeria and role linking capital to Eastern provinces.
wiki_only_topics.quote_wikipedia: Being connected to Rome through the Via Tiburtina and its extension the Via Valeria, Aternum played a crucial role in connecting the capital to the Eastern provinces of the Empire.

wiki_only_topics.topic: Use of the harbour by commercial, fishing, and supposedly military ships.
wiki_only_topics.quote_wikipedia: Its harbour, largely occupied by commercial and fishing ships, was supposedly also used for military purposes.

wiki_only_topics.topic: The temple of Jovis Aternium and other temples to Roman and Egyptian divinities.
wiki_only_topics.quote_wikipedia: The main building was the temple of Jovis Aternium but there are traces of other temples dedicated to Roman and even Egyptian divinities.

wiki_only_topics.topic: Construction of a monumental bridge by the emperor Tiberius.
wiki_only_topics.quote_wikipedia: Moreover, there are reports about the construction of a monumental bridge by the emperor Tiberius.

wiki_only_topics.topic: Alternative name Ostia Aterni due to location at the mouth of the river Aternus.
wiki_only_topics.quote_wikipedia: Some historians also refer to Aternum with the name of Ostia Aterni, due to its location at the mouth of the river Aternus.
